name: TextOCR
recommended_action: Reserve 50% of the OCR sample for randomly selected natural scene images.
notes: Local train annotations cover 21,778 images; 29 have no transcribed words. '.' marks unreadable/non-English regions. Word annotation order is not guaranteed reading order. Extra local images without these annotations are not sampled.

name: PRISM Adversarial Images
recommended_action: Exclude from the current OCR evaluation; retain only as adversarial-image research data.
notes: The available semantic prompt metadata is not suitable OCR ground truth for this evaluation.

name: VisInject
recommended_action: Exclude from text-injection OCR evaluation; retain for later MLL pixel-perturbation work.
notes: Pixel-level adversarial attack, not rendered text injection; target_phrase is the intended VLM response, not image text.

name: Visual Adversarial Examples Jailbreak LLMs
recommended_action: Keep the five attack images as research artifacts, not OCR ground truth.

name: PHANTOM
recommended_action: Keep outside active OCR metadata; retain the archival shard and upstream data for provenance.
notes: 48,575 image-turn metadata rows; 23 IDEATOR references are absent from the release manifest.

name: MM-SafetyBench
recommended_action: Sample TYPO and SD_TYPO from matched question groups; SD backgrounds and orphan images are excluded.
notes: OCR reference covers the rendered Key Phrase only; SD backgrounds may contain other untranscribed text.

name: FigStep
recommended_action: Excluded from OCR sources by user request; raw files remain in the local inventory.

name: Multimodal Injection
recommended_action: Demo and result images rather than a labeled OCR dataset.

name: CyberSecEval3 Visual Prompt Injection
recommended_action: Sample existing images with image_text only; exclude 100 judge-only CAPTCHA targets and missing images.

name: VPI-Bench
recommended_action: Sample unique screenshots with source-declared Silver target references; BBC is excluded.
notes: 227 active testcase references map to 190 unique rendered URLs; 79 BBC cases/screenshots are excluded from OCR. The original upstream BBC configurations are retained. 36 remaining popup configurations reference a missing background image; no unreferenced screenshots remain in the active folder.

name: Anamorpher
recommended_action: Evaluate the generated challenge using the recorded resampler, target size and target region; keep failed controls separate.
notes: Generated images live under research/datasets/data/derived/anamorpher/v1; the upstream demos are not OCR ground truth. Payload is reference text after declared downscale, not a certified native-resolution transcript.

name: Typographic Visual Prompt Injection
recommended_action: Imported 135 images; keep all three styles of each prompt in the same eval split.
notes: 45 prompt texts mapped to clean, lowcontrast, and distorted images; line breaks and text regions are not annotated.
